d:
Hi. It took me a while, but I finally finished this whole sequence. I'd been wanting to create a new boy character for a long time, but I couldn't decide on a single archetype, so I used my two favorites for this kind of thing: the chubby and the femboy.

I hope you enjoy the sequences. I think drawing the different outfits makes the scene more exciting. I also had fun drawing the chastity cages. Actually, I prefer the ones that allow for more space, but I felt this salt shaker design would create a more striking visual effect in certain images.

But for some reason, I still can't think of any names for my characters ':-T
